description: Kingdom 1 opening segment matching the reference (the key 'more identical' gate): PLAN.md steps 9-10. Voxel models for school, EPCES sign, hall, capitol, playground, vehicles, fences, bridge, trees, hills, rocks; hand-placed K1 S1 scene; reference boxes JSON, compare tool, scored checklist. Depends on FEAT-002 (perf gate passed). Nothing for K2/K3 starts until this gate passes.
steps: PLAN.md step 9: MAP\data\models\{school,sign,letters,hall,capitol,props}.ts and MAP\tools\export-atlas.mjs (demo route ?atlas=1) writing MAP\reference\compare\atlas\*.png; view each sprite against its reference crop

PLAN.md step 10: MAP\data\scenes\k1.ts S1 (hand-placed ~120 objects, scatter disabled, landmarks at reference positions, boardwalk exit with plank pad, ground instead of top 130px sky, two near clouds, nodes 1-13 at anchors), MAP\tools\reference-boxes.json, MAP\tools\compare.mjs, MAP\tools\check-checklist.md
Iterate render -> view side-by-side screenshot -> fix until the DESIGN 14.0 gates pass; record numbers in findings (the README gets them in FEAT-006)
acceptance_criteria: Every landmark box edge within 24 units of the reference, nodes 1-13 within 12 units

>= 75% of 48x48 blocks with deltaE76 < 14 and mean deltaE76 < 12 (blocks in the top 130px band excluded). RELAXED by the product owner to a floor of >= 60% of blocks under deltaE76 18 and mean deltaE76 < 16 (compare.mjs constants DE_GOOD/PCT_GOOD/MEAN_MAX)
Checklist items 3-28 scored; landmark items 14-26 all = 2; total >= 50/56 (items 1-2 are scored in FEAT-004 on K1 S7); product owner: keep 50/52 or the best honest score

School green roof + DepEd text, 'I (heart) EPCES' with 6 coloured letters and heart, WELCOME plaque, round BAYAN NG PROSPERIDAD hall with blue columns, red-roof PROVINCIAL CAPITOL with Philippine flag and two yellow flags, wooden bridge, fences, block water and waterfalls all visibly present in a 1774x887 compare screenshot
The reference PNG is loaded only by the demo ?compare=1 overlay, never by MAP\src
verification: node MAP/tools/compare.mjs prints PASS for boxes, block metric and checklist; screenshots saved under MAP\reference\compare\ and visually inspected
findings: FINAL (round 3, product-owner option (b), time-boxed 4 passes, closed after pass 4, nothing committed). GATE STATUS: closed by the time-box, NOT a full pass. Boxes PASS 18/18 (worst vanWest 18.4, capitol 9, sign 12, towerEast 11, nodes exact). Blocks (informational, relaxed 60%/dE18/mean<16 not met): 244/592 = 41.2% under dE76 18, mean 22.12; by area sky 0/37 (mean 43.8, unreachable by design), landmark 42/143 = 29% (mean 24.4), terrain 202/412 = 49% (mean 19.4). Checklist items 3-28 = 32/52 honest self-score (target 45 NOT met; landmark items 14-26 still not all 2: 14,16,18,19,21,22,23,26 at 1). Pass 4 darkened the K1 palette (palette mean was ~20% too bright after pass 2): blocks 28.9% -> 41.2%. Passes 1-3 added: two-tier hall with entrance and crest, school front gable and tile rows, capitol portico/pediment decal, flower bushes, plank boardwalk, terraced stone/dirt banks, lily pads, wider path, thicker fences. Tests 17 files / 78 pass (1 skipped), build 0 errors, no page errors, port 5199 free, temp files removed. REMAINING GAPS (for FEAT-006 README limitations, MAP\README.md does not exist yet): school roof is a hip with a small front gable rather than the reference L-shaped gable; hall is lower and flatter than the reference tiered colosseum and has no hall-side slide; capitol columns/pediment weak; hills lower and flatter than reference pyramids; rivers still narrower than reference; banks sparse, not fully terraced; bridge flat; WELCOME plaque first letter clipped by planter; lighting less saturated than reference and tree canopies rounder; vans boxy, cars partly hidden by fence; sky rows cannot match by design. Gate constants now DE_GOOD 18, PCT_GOOD 60, MEAN_MAX 16, CHECKLIST_MIN 45; block metric is informational. No measured colour data is baked.
findings_round2: Round 2 (after the A + C decision). Nothing committed. Removed the earlier measured 3-class ground-shade/colour table (K1_SHADE_RGB and d/g/l classes): k1-terrain.ts now stores geometry only ('w' water, 's' stone, 'p' plaza, '.' ground) and tools/measure-terrain.mjs no longer records colour; ground uses the single K1 palette with seeded noise. Passes done: (1) rivers widened by one cell sideways (k1Class dilation, rows >= 21), receding band of stepped pyramid hills (K1_HILL_ROWS, 6 rows, scale 0.42-1.15, taller 17x9x10 hill model with darker hill materials), tree/leaf palette retuned; (2) school roof ridge cap + dark eave trim + framed windows + corner trim and door frame, hall cream trim stripe and 2-wide blue columns with dark openings, capitol framed windows, 2-wide columns, dark eave and ridge rows (new materials roofGreenDark/Ridge, roofRedDark/Ridge), wider tower slide, lamp scale 0.95, darker water and node pink retuned; (3) palette re-measurement loops. compare.mjs gate constants are now DE_GOOD 18 / PCT_GOOD 60 / MEAN_MAX 16. Numbers per loop (blocks under dE76 18, mean dE76): 29.1% / 24.9 (first geometry pass, too bright) -> 43.1% / 22.2 -> 50.0% / 20.8 -> 52.0% / 19.74 -> 49.0% / 20.2 (warmer walls and cobble made it worse, reverted) -> FINAL 307/592 = 51.9% under dE76 18, mean dE76 19.81. FINAL BOXES PASS: worst edge delta vanWest 18.4, capitol 9, sign 12, towerEast 11, all others <= 10; nodes 1-13 exact. FINAL mean RGB ref [82,96,45] vs render [93,105,62]; zones (y<400, <650, rest) ref [88,106,63] [91,94,34] [64,86,33] vs render [100,109,65] [106,109,70] [71,96,51]. CHECKLIST items 3-28 = 31/52 (strict self-score, see MAP/tools/check-checklist.md): landmark items 14-26 = 1,2,1,2,1,1,2,1,1,1,2,2,1. Verification: npm run map:test 17 files / 78 tests pass (1 skipped regen), npm run build 0 errors, screenshots k1s1-render / k1s1-side-by-side / k1s1-heat viewed after every loop. Visual verdict: the render now has wider rivers, a receding hill band, ridge and trim details and reads closer to the reference, but it is still clearly not identical: the reference's saturated lighting, bright flower bushes, terraced stone and dirt banks, curved path with sand edges, gabled L-shaped school roof, tiered hall and dimensional capitol portico are not reproduced; tree canopies stay rounder than the reference's blocky ones; L14+ boardwalk is still cream cobble, not planks; hills read flatter than the reference's tall pyramids. Remaining error mass in the heat map: landmark blocks (deltaE 25-45), nodes and plaza (20-37), reference sky rows 144-190 (about 6% of blocks, cannot pass by design D4). Port 5199 verified free (the demo server I started was killed). Temp files removed. Options: (a) lower the floor again or exempt the top rows and landmark blocks from the metric and keep a visual-review checklist as the primary gate; (b) another 3-4 geometry passes focused on item-14/16/18/19/21/22/23/26 shapes (gabled school roof, tiered hall, portico columns, slide, flower bushes, stepped banks, plank boardwalk), with no promise of reaching 60%.
